options.skyboxify.title: Skyboxify Configuration
options.skyboxify.processOptiFine.toolti: If enabled, the mod will attempt to read/load OptiFine Custom Skies.
options.skyboxify.processMCPatcher.toolt: If enabled, the mod will attempt to read/load MCPatcher Custom Skies.
options.skyboxify.renderSunMoon.tooltip: Enable/disable rendering of the sun and moon.
options.skyboxify.showOverworldForUnknow: Will show the overworld skyboxes in unknown dimensions. Will not show in nether/end though unless a skybox defines it.
options.skyboxify.ignoreBrokenSkies.tool: If something inside of a sky layer fails to load, it will ignore it and not load it.
